literal: The end of deliberation is attaining resolution; that resolution lingering in delay is harmful.
translation: The end of deliberation is to arrive at a firm resolution; but for that resolution to linger in delay is harmful.
modern: ஆராய்ச்சியின் முடிவு ஒரு தெளிவான முடிவை அடைவதாகும்; அவ்வாறு எடுத்த முடிவு செயலில் இறங்காமல் காலதாமதத்தில் தங்கிவிடுவது தீமையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the transition from planning to action. The ultimate goal of any deliberation (சூழ்ச்சி) is to arrive at a firm, unwavering decision (துணிவு). However, once a decision has been reached, allowing that resolution to linger in procrastination or delay (தாழ்ச்சி) is highly detrimental. Hesitation after planning defeats the purpose of the initial analysis and leads to failure.
